reason: Buying the bottle alone comes to $63 with that $13 shipping, which is ridiculous, and the only way around it is signing up for a filter subscription I know I'll forget to cancel. A 5% creator code isn't enough for me to pay $68 today for a gym bottle.
objection: They're using free shipping to push me into a subscription. I'd end up paying for filters I never asked for long after I've stopped using the bottle.
would_change_my_mind: Free shipping on the bottle by itself with no subscription, plus a real launch discount of 20% or more, so I'd get it for about $35-40 and buy filters only when I need them.
